description: Demande d'électricité au Québec is a dataset listed in Données Québec open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Hydro-Québec. Jeu de données d’Hydro‑Québec sur la demande d’électricité au Québec en mégawatts. Mises à jour toutes les 15 minutes, elles montrent les variations du besoin quotidien d’électricité en fonction de l’heure de la journée. Coverage: Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Hydro-Québec. Its tags are HackQC22. It offers 2 resource(s) in HTML, JSON. The portal shows 2024-03-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Attribution, pas d’utilisation commerciale (CC-BY-NC 4.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-quebec-portal.
